description: Itinéraires cyclables de Soissons is a dataset listed in GrandSoissons Agglomération open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Soissons. Cartographie des itinéraires cyclables de la ville de Soissons en 2020. Coverage: Grand Soissons Agglomération. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are mobilite, cyclable, mobilité douce, velo, vélo. The portal shows 106 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ville-soissons-fr-portal.
